_source: Watched in the owner's Chrome 2026-11-17: frames every ~2.5-3 s, words from YouTube's transcript panel (Hindi narration). Our own descriptions; shots are approximate from sampled frames.

hook.firstFrame: a satellite world map tilting toward the viewer
hook.firstLine: Let's talk about Chile, not the pepper; why is it so long?

shots.picture: a red chili pepper laid over Chile's outline on a terrain map
Chile's red outline stretched with the word LOOOONG along it
Chile's red shape dragged over India from Kashmir down
the red shape over India with a yellow distance label and a measuring line
close terrain of a narrow valley with small flags marking settlements
Chile's red strip with a white arrow shape across it on a terrain map
the Andes highlighted in orange along the red strip of Chile
South America pulled back, Chile alone in red
Bolivia appears in blue beside Chile, then shrinks back from the coast
the whole continent, Chile in red and Bolivia in blue, pulling away

lines.gist: a pepper pun, then the question why the country is so long
its length compared with India's north-south span
how narrow it is, under a hundred km in places
colonial borders followed the coast as settlers spread
the Andes act as a wall that fixed the eastern edge
a war with its neighbours moved the northern border
mountains on one side, ocean on the other, a war at the top

ending.lastFrame: South America with Chile red and Bolivia blue

whyItWorks: a pun on the name in the first second, then a question the viewer can't answer
the strange shape dropped onto the viewer's own country for scale
a new map move every 3 seconds: drag, zoom into relief, recolour a neighbour
one thread of cause: mountains, coast, war, each shown on the map
